verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a community remark that Fly provisions Let's Encrypt certificates but charges for them, plus a vendor note that every Sprite gets an HTTPS URL. That shows some managed TLS exists, but the 'free' part is undercut, and automatic renewal, custom-domain coverage and wildcard support are not documented. Missing for 10: first-party docs on custom-domain certificate provisioning, evidence of automatic renewal, wildcard certificate support, evidence the certificates are free.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can get free, automatically renewing TLS certificates for every domain including wildcards

citations.quote: Dislikes being charged for free Let's Encrypt certs.
Every Sprite has an HTTPS URL.
